verdict.rationale: The evidence lists accepted payment methods (card, PayPal, Venmo, ACH, Apple Pay), but nothing documents supported onboarding countries, local payment methods by region, or local-currency settlement. Onboarding references to SSNs and ACH bank validation imply a single-market setup rather than a published geographic coverage map. A flat payment-method list is not a country/currency coverage map, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, sellers can join from where they are — supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, and local-currency settlement documented as a coverage map, not discovered ticket by ticket
